goal: the scenario «The Howl of the Chimeras (Albert Estrada Zambrano, Shadowlands Ediciones / Chaosium, 2025, Victorian Scotland)» playable from the base, a work of the English series (Р-251)
extra:
## This work (Р-251, English works series, one at a time)

Source: the English original `howl-of-the-chimeras-en` (text layer; `python -B pipeline/source/pages.py show howl-of-the-chimeras-en <page>`; page image `python -B pipeline/source/pages.py image howl-of-the-chimeras-en <physical page> --physical`). Page numbers: `pagemap` often misses printed numbers in these PDFs — look at 2–3 page images and find printed vs physical; in `sources` give the printed page as printed (null for unnumbered pages). Offset is already set (printed = physical − 1; `show` takes the printed page). Do NOT edit `pipeline/source/books.json` — report any other offset (physical = printed − offset, e.g. «p. 3» on physical 4 → offset −1) and the lead sets it.
Russian text — our translation (flag `translated`); official Russian forms of names and terms — glossary `python -B tools/terms.py <word>` and existing records (Р-184), e.g. Dreamlands = «Страна грёз»; Hard/Extreme roll = «трудная/чрезвычайная проверка» (official «трудный/чрезвычайный успех», never «сложная»). New terms of this book — choose one Russian form each, use it everywhere, and list them all in your report (English → Russian); the translator of the book will reuse exactly these forms.
- FIRST: check that this scenario is not already in the base under a Russian translation (Grep key character and place names, transliterated, in `kb/books/*-ru/`; e.g. «The Haunted Clubhouse» was already there as «Маленький клуб ужасов»). If it is — do NOT create a second set: per Р-147 the translation keeps the text, the original gives the numbers; write proposals to the translation records (English sources, `name.en`, errata for translation errors) and report.
- Victorian Scotland, Dewar Castle: era gaslight. A big adventure (220 pages) split into 4 units — see «Shared scheme» below.
- One `scenario` record (summary, keeper_info, hook, advice, steps with refs, conclusion with Sanity rewards, tables), every scene (`arc`), characters (stat blocks as printed, Р-25; pregenerated investigators are characters with role `pregen`; unnamed crowds — group profile with invented `names`, Р-151), creatures (known Mythos creatures and deities → `instance_of` the shared record, Grep `kb/creatures` first; a unique being — book record), organizations, items and clues, tomes and spells (known spells → refs to the shared `coc:spell:*`), handouts (text as printed + our full translation), places (a real city — the shared record `coc:location:<city>` if it exists (Grep first), book places `part_of` it; a fictional town — a book place with its places `part_of` it; do not create shared records in `kb/locations/`), maps (`map` records with a spot on every printed label, Р-206; every key number without a record gets a small place record).
- Helper scripts — only in your own scratchpad subfolder `gen-howl` (other helpers run in parallel and use the same scratchpad).
- Book-scoped ids `howl-of-the-chimeras-en/<kind>/<slug>` in `kb/books/howl-of-the-chimeras-en/<kinds>/`.
- Pictures (skill `.claude/skills/kb-art/SKILL.md`, Р-241, Р-245): portraits, creature art, handouts, item pictures, maps — mapping `checks/20261116-howl/art.json`, `python -B pipeline/art/add_images.py … --dry-run` then real; apply the proposals yourself (`pipeline/integrate/apply.py`) — you own this book; atmosphere pictures (cover, decoration, mood art not tied to a record) → `checks/20261116-howl/atmosphere.json` (the lead merges it). File prefix for pictures: `howl-`.
- Lessons from earlier checks (skill kb-import, «Ошибки, которые уже находили»): every page of an entry in `sources`; handout texts in full; maps are `map` records, not atmosphere; no two records with the same `name.ru`; terms inside text agree with the record names; book misprints kept as printed, in `errata`, with the obvious ones fixed in `corrections`.
- When done, run `python -I -B tools/completeness.py --books howl-of-the-chimeras-en --out checks/20261116-howl/completeness` and `python -I -B tools/scenario_check.py --books howl-of-the-chimeras-en --out checks/20261116-howl/scenario` and fix what they find; then `python -B tools/check.py kb/books/howl-of-the-chimeras-en` — 0 errors.
- Coverage: in `checks/20261116-howl/howl.md` list every heading of the book → the record that holds it (or «не взято» with the reason), misprints, and the term list (English → Russian).

## Shared scheme of this book (4 units work in parallel — keep to it exactly)

The book (220 pages) is split into 4 units; each unit writes ONLY its own files. Refer to records of other units by the ids below even before they exist — dangling refs to these ids are expected until all units finish (list them in your report); do not create stubs for them.
- Characters `howl-of-the-chimeras-en/character/<slug>` (unit npcs): amadeus-dewar, edna-dewar, eldon-dove, orpheus, lenora-redding, elizabeth-milford, horace-oconnell (his crew — group profile `oconnell-crew`), garret-wilton, hank-sherman, patsy-sherman, esther-sherman, amelia-sherman, flora-sherman, selina-bainbridge, julius-collingwood, henrietta-younis, victor-burdett, ralph-laverik, peter-helm, barnabas-gauntlett (his men — `gauntlett-men`), poachers; pregens arthur-wiltshire, gladys-cosgrove, jasper-bramley; others mentioned (Dramatis Personae «Other Characters Mentioned») — slug of the English name without title.
- Places `howl-of-the-chimeras-en/location/<slug>` (units castle and estate): root `dewar-castle` (unit castle), floors `dewar-castle-ground-floor`, `dewar-castle-second-floor`, `dewar-castle-third-floor`, `dewar-castle-basement` (unit castle), estate root `lairds-estate` (unit estate) `part_of` nothing book-external (a fictional estate in Scotland — Grep `kb/locations` for a shared Scotland record and use it if it exists); rooms and estate spots — slug of the English key name (e.g. `cellar`, `laboratory`, `gardens`, `smugglers-cove`); on a clash add the floor (`ground-floor-…`).
- Scenes `howl-of-the-chimeras-en/scene/<slug>` (unit core): slug of the English heading (`the-arrival`, `the-dinner`, `the-confrontation`, floating scenes `floating-<slug>`…); the scenario `howl-of-the-chimeras-en/scenario/howl-of-the-chimeras` (unit core).
- Items: the Charon Machine `charon-machine`, the music box `music-box`, the Inca treasure `inca-treasure`, the Chimera `howl-of-the-chimeras-en/creature/chimera` — unit core. Lord Dewar's books (p. 142–152) → `howl-of-the-chimeras-en/tome/<slug>` or `item/<slug>` — unit estate.
- Handouts `howl-of-the-chimeras-en/handout/handout-<N>-<slug>` (unit npcs); Handout 1 (castle interior maps) and Handout 2 (estate map) are `map` records owned by units castle and estate respectively (`howl-of-the-chimeras-en/map/…`), and the handout records of 1–2 are not needed — the map record notes it is a player handout.
- Separate PDFs registered as books (text layer + `image`): `howl-chimeras-cards-en` (NPC cards, 6 p.), `howl-chimeras-handouts-en` (game handouts, 9 p.), `howl-chimeras-sheets-en` (pregen sheets, 12 p.), `howl-chimeras-maps-en` (2 p., big maps). Four large map PDFs in the library folder `Карты` (MAP01–MAP04_EN.pdf — render with `pdftoppm -r 100 -png`, if needed). The folder also has `SotDG_Passports.pdf` (blank 1920s US passport templates) and `Раздатка/Arkham_AdvertiserA3_EN.pdf` (a 2024 promotional newspaper) — they do not belong to this scenario: unit npcs looks at them, confirms and notes «не взято» with the reason. `Tokens_for_online_games/` — round tokens of the NPC portraits; use only if the book has no portrait of someone.
- Victorian Scotland: era `gaslight`. Very graphic adult content (self-harm, necrophagy, sexual content): describe factually and briefly in the records.
- Coverage file `checks/20261116-howl/howl-<unit>.md` per unit (not one shared file); terms per unit there too. Art mapping `checks/20261116-howl/art-<unit>.json`, atmosphere `atmosphere-<unit>.json`, proposals `proposals-<unit>.json`, pictures prefix `howl-`.
- completeness/scenario_check run by unit core only at the end, after the others; the other units run `python -B tools/check.py <your files>` and report remaining errors (only dangling refs to the scheme ids are acceptable).
